messages:
Jordan: Starting in 10m; small agenda change: quick hiring update moved to right before Q&A. Please keep roadmap questions short for the live block.
Lina: noted. Also we have an external guest (Claire) joining remotely — can VideoOps confirm greenroom link?
VideoOps: Greenroom link: https://studio.redwood/greenroom/1769100001. Claire, join 5m early. OBS scene prepared.
Claire: joining greenroom now. audio/mic test: "Claire check one two"
StreamBot: Preflight OK. captions: ON. recording target: s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1769100001.mp4
Mateo: heads up: slide deck v2 uploaded; please use that instead of v1. I'll pin it in the presentation queue.
Jordan: thanks @Mateo. DevEx, can you flag presenters to use v2?
DevExBot: Pinged presenters. Checklist: mute desktop audio, use headset, use slide deck v2.
VideoOps: mic check passed for Claire and Lina. OBS warns about duplicate audio source in scene 'All-hands' — removing desktop audio now.
OpsBot: captions edge health: us-west 99.99, eu 99.98, apac 99.93. Watching TTL propagation.
StreamBot: Recording started. viewers: 9 (pre). reactions: :wave: 
Claire: presenting; audio feels faint on my end — anyone else?
Mateo: preview shows Claire ~-6dB vs others. bumping gain +4dB on the greenroom mix.
VideoOps: placing marker at 10:11 for slight audio imbalance. will export raw + mixed audio for editor.
Lina: small caption blip at 10:14:05 for ~3s in apac. Ops?
OpsBot: captions failover engaged briefly to captions-b at 10:14:08. marker placed.
Jordan: keep going, annotate the recording and we'll publish corrected transcript. Leadership Q&A will answer the dedicated region pinning and cost questions.
StreamBot: Recording stopped. Uploading file: all-hands-1769100001.mp4.
OpsBot: Upload complete. Transcode finished. 1080p mp4 and captions at https://files.redwood/recordings/1769100001. checksums OK.
Jordan: thanks everyone — retro tomorrow 11:00 for stream ops. Please add edits and follow-ups to the board.
